comparison.objective: Tune a shock absorber vs tension and safely cut an anchored cord.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key use and fine rotary force control vs bimanual tensioning plus knife orientation and cutting away from the holding hand.
comparison.success_condition: Two acceptable carriage cycles and lock retention vs cord severed at a safe location and knife released without blade contact or dropped parts.
comparison.reason: Bimanual force control is generic; controlled cutting of a deformable cord is meaningfully different. Missing rubric detail: cutting calibration is referenced externally, but novelty is unambiguous.
